security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: The Paddock app shell as an app, to check the shared UI
bundle.longDescription: Paddock Shell Demo shows the shared shell of the Paddock apps for real: pages, service health with Repair, notifications, jobs with phases and Cancel, Settings, dialogs of every kind, About, Updates, What's New and the tray popover. It is also the starter for new Paddock apps.
